title: Restore a business name
summary: This page explains the process for restoring a business name that has been cancelled due to non-renewal.
intro:
If your business name has been cancelled because you did not renew it by the due date, you have 6 months to contact the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) and ask for it to be restored.

If it has been more than 6 months since your business name was cancelled, you cannot restore it. You need to check if it's still available and register it again.
who_can_apply: The business name must have been cancelled because it was not renewed by the due date.

external_links.text: When ASIC cancels a business name – ASIC

faqs.q: How long do I have to restore a cancelled business name?
faqs.a: If your business name was cancelled because you did not renew it, you have 6 months to contact the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) and ask for it to be restored.

faqs.q: What happens if it has been more than 6 months since my business name was cancelled?
faqs.a: If it has been more than 6 months since your business name was cancelled, you cannot restore it. You must check if it is still available and register it again.
